_doc: Reward penalty weights per environment (envs/boxing.py, envs/footwork.py, envs/getup.py), read by training/reward_config.py. Each is charged as -weight * term per control step; torque_sq = sum of actuator torque squared (N m)^2, joint_vel_sq = sum of joint speed squared (rad/s)^2, ang_vel_sq = pelvis roll/pitch angular velocity squared, action_rate = |a_t - a_(t-1)|^2, foot_slip = foot planar speed squared while in contact. torque_sq and joint_vel_sq were added 2026-11-20: every shipped brain was trained without them (no retraining). The game's copy for the Tab overlay is Assets/Settings/RewardWeights.asset (kept equal by RewardWeightsTests).
